name: inspira-lens
title: Lens Magnifier
blurb: Magnifying lens overlay that zooms in on hover.
description: Wrapper creating a circular magnifying lens showing zoomed content. Lens follows cursor on hover or stays at fixed position if static.
use_when: Product images, detailed inspections, or interactive galleries needing zoom magnification.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces — hover and pointer tracking required.
a11y: Wrapper only; focus and keyboard behavior come from children. Lens is visual enhancement.
